result:
Root cause: in `makeMove`'s `mkPlace` block the promoted piece was built as `mkPiece OR promoType` instead of `mkSide OR promoType`, so the pawn's own bit 0 (WP=1 / BP=9) leaked into the result and turned R (type 4) into Q (5) and N (type 2) into B (3), while Q (5) and B (3) — already having bit 0 set — survived unharmed.

Files touched:
- variants/bug03/movegen.inc — the fix: `ld a,(mkPiece)` -> `ld a,(mkSide)` at mkPlace, plus two comment lines. One code byte differs in the assembled tape (Z80 0x903E, 0xB0->0xB1); same length, all label addresses unchanged.
- variants/bug03/test_promotion.py — new regression test (identity 16 cases, behaviour 24 cases, self-test 3 cases).
- variants/bug03/Makefile — promotion gate appended to `make test`; new `test-promotion` target.
- variants/bug03/BUILD.md — documents both.
- FIX_NOTES.md, STATE.md at the workspace root.

Gate status:
- Reported symptom: pass. Every repro command in the report now gives the chosen piece — a7a8r -> R3k3/... material 500, a7a8n -> N320, a7a8q -> Q900, a7a8b -> B330, a2a1r -> r -500. Capture-promotions on the last rank were checked too and are correct for both colours.
- make test: pass, exit 0. All five pre-existing checks still green, plus the new gate.
- New test: pass — 97 checks, 0 failed on the fixed tape; 35 failed checks across 17 cases on the pre-fix tape, so it would have caught this bug.
- Built-in T self-test: pass — promotion d3 62379 OK, incr key/phase/pst OK, PERFT OK - movegen verified.
- Characterisation suite: pass — 57 ok, 0 failed, exit 0 (pre-fix: 53 ok, 4 failed). Since it is recorded from the pristine build, this is independent evidence the repair restores pristine behaviour rather than just hiding the symptom. It needs an explicit --harness "$PWD/harness"; its default path points outside this workspace.
- Review: clean at round 1 of a maximum 3. Verdict NO DEFECT IN THE FIX, no blocking findings. The reviewer reconstructed the pre-fix build from source itself rather than trusting my copy, matched its md5, and showed by binary comparison that the entire behavioural delta is one operand byte — so any path reaching mkPlace without a promotion is identical machine code to before. It also confirmed the promptPromo key scan is correct against the emulator's own key matrix, so the fix is sufficient and not merely necessary.

Knowingly left open (recorded in FIX_NOTES.md, non-blocking per the termination rule):
- Makefile SRC lists chess.asm, movegen.inc, engine.inc and pieces.inc but not perft.inc, zobrist.inc or tt.inc, so edits to those three will not trigger a rebuild. Pre-existing, out of scope here, and widening it deserves its own check against the byte-for-byte rebuild guarantee.
- The new gate adds roughly 50 seconds to make test. The 16-second self-test group is already excluded there and kept in make test-promotion.
- The identity group's material assertion is a second view of the same board image rather than a second independent observation; the behaviour group is the independent signal. The engine's own Matl panel would be engine-side but reads in whole pawns, so it cannot tell a bishop from a knight — the half of this bug that most needs discriminating.
- The pre-fix tape exists only at /tmp/bug03_buggy.tap, outside the workspace. It is reconstructible by reverting the one operand and running make, which is what the reviewer did.
